old_description: Our team specializes in custom fabrication, installation and delivery – a service that greatly benefits projects with tight deadlines. At Tampa Metal Works, we take pride in supporting local businesses. That’s what we work with trusted partners to ensure you receive the quality you deserve.
about:
Tampa Metal Works Inc operates from Tampa, Florida, where it has provided metal fabrication and installation services across the state for nearly 40 years. The company is locally owned and operated, though no founding year or founder names are disclosed.

The shop specializes in custom metal fabrication, including in-house manufacturing of scuppers, downspouts, handrails, chimney caps, and collector boxes using brake metal and flat stock. It also performs field welding and on-site installation, and offers prompt delivery services. The facility warehouses a broad inventory of flat stock to support quick turnaround.

Primary customers are commercial contractors in the roofing, sheet metal, and construction trades. The company serves projects throughout Hillsborough, Pinellas, Pasco, Polk, Manatee, Hardee, Highlands, Sarasota, and DeSoto counties, with nationwide shipping available.

Tampa Metal Works emphasizes its understanding of contractor challenges, citing durable results, fast turnaround from stocked inventory, and reliable delivery as key differentiators. It holds a Florida roofing contractor license (CCC1329561) and follows SMACNA standards, with memberships in FRSA and NRCA.

name: Tasly Pharmaceuticals, Inc
old_description: At Tasly Pharmaceuticals Inc. (TPI), we are dedicated to delivering effective, safe, and highquality botanical medicines that complement modern medical practices. Our innovative solutions provide a synergistic approach to healthcare, offering patients alternative and long-term treatment options while working alongside conventional medicine.
about:
Tasly Pharmaceuticals, Inc. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Rockville, Maryland. The company was established to integrate botanical science with modern pharmaceutical innovation, developing safe, effective, and scientifically validated botanical medicines that complement conventional treatments.

The company develops and manufactures botanical drugs, most notably T89 (Dantonic), the first herbal medicine-derived compound to complete an FDA Phase III global clinical trial. Production runs on what Tasly describes as the world's largest proprietary automatic dripping pill and packaging line, a fully automated system that handles feeding, precision pill counting, labeling, real-time imprint monitoring, and automated removal of non-conforming units. The line operates under global digital control. Supporting processes include extraction, condensation, chromatography, crystallization, filtration, and drying, governed by Good Extracting Practice standards. Tasly holds more than 500 regulatory approvals worldwide.

Tasly serves the pharmaceutical and healthcare sectors, focusing on cardiovascular indications such as stable ischemic heart disease and chronic stable angina, and metabolic conditions like hyperlipidemia. Clinical programs include the ORESA and CAESA trials; Phase III data were presented at the American College of Cardiology meeting. Collaboration partners have included the Trade Winds ASEAN Mission and BioJapan, indicating a global commercial and research orientation.

The company differentiates itself through an end-to-end quality system spanning Good Manufacturing Practice, Good Agricultural Practice for raw-material cultivation, Good Extracting Practice, and Good Laboratory Practice. This integrated approach, combined with the proprietary automated line, aims to ensure batch-to-batch consistency and bridge traditional botanical knowledge with modern pharmaceutical validation.

name: Tech Energy America LLC
old_description: Tech Energy America is a wholesale electrical distributor in Scottsdale, AZ — transformers, wire & cable, and UL-listed switchgear for contractors and industrial, since 2009.
about:
Tech Energy America LLC operates from Scottsdale, Arizona, where it was founded in 2009. The company began when contractors and industrial buyers in the region struggled to obtain straight pricing and reliable delivery from large national distributors, prompting the founders to build a wholesale supply house focused on transparency and speed.

The business runs two complementary lines: wholesale distribution of transformers, wire and cable, conduit, breakers, panelboards, and related electrical materials, plus in-house manufacturing of UL-listed switchgear, panelboards, and VFDs at its Scottsdale facility. As Arizona representative for JST Power, CME Wire, Priority Wire, and Southwire — and authorized source for Square D/Schneider Electric, Allied Tube, and Cantex — it stocks pad-mount transformers (12.47/34.5 kV, 500–3,500 kVA), PV wire, XHHW-2, and EV charging equipment, shipping nationwide via freight.

Customers include licensed electrical contractors, solar EPCs and builders such as Solar Gain Inc., industrial buyers, and resellers across Arizona’s major metros — Scottsdale, Phoenix, Mesa, Tempe, Chandler, Gilbert, Glendale, Peoria, and Tucson — with statewide delivery on request and wholesale freight nationwide. The firm supplies materials only; installation is handled by sister company ConstruTech Group.

The company emphasizes three commitments: a fully bilingual English/Spanish team from ownership through order logistics, same-day RFQ turnaround on most bills of materials, and documentation by default including spec sheets and manufacturer warranty paperwork. In-house switchgear assembly cuts typical lead times to 4–8 weeks for standard 480V/600V assemblies, versus 16–26 weeks from out-of-state OEMs.

name: TechNH, Inc.
old_description: Our proven 5-step transfer process protects supply continuity, confirms tool condition, and gets you back to stable production fast.
about:
TechNH, Inc. was founded in 1982 in a small corner of an old mill building in Nashua, New Hampshire. The company has since relocated to Merrimack, New Hampshire, where it operates as a custom plastic injection molder serving clients worldwide.

The company specializes in precision plastic injection molding, offering insert molding, over-molding, and in-house mold making and repair. Secondary services include pad printing, assembly, and packaging. TechNH also provides design for manufacturability, mold flow analysis, and IQ/OQ/PQ validation through an in-house regulatory team. Workforce tenure is notable: nearly 40% of employees have over five years of service, and 25% have exceeded a decade.

TechNH serves the medical, defense, alternative energy, water treatment, and industrial sectors. Customer testimonials reference clients in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Pennsylvania, including healthcare and industrial accounts. The company is ISO 13485:2016 certified by TUV, FDA registered (21 CFR 820), ITAR registered, and UL recognized.

A core differentiator is the company's five-step tool transfer process, designed to protect supply continuity and confirm tool condition without production downtime. TechNH emphasizes in-house mold making and regulatory expertise, allowing it to maintain compliance with critical standards alongside customers. Long-tenured staff and a culture built on adaptability, integrity, enthusiasm, pride in work, and reliability underpin its approach.

In-house regulatory team for ISO 13485, ITAR, FDA, and UL compliance

name: Technotronix
old_description: AS9100/ISO 9001 custom cable and wire harness assemblies (secondary to PCB assembly)
about:
Technotronix operates from Anaheim, California, where it was founded in 1981. The company has grown over more than four decades into a full-service printed circuit board manufacturer serving OEMs, startups, and enterprises across multiple sectors.

The company provides end-to-end PCB services including layout, fabrication, assembly (through-hole, surface-mount, and mixed technology), box build, cable and wire harness assembly, and metal fabrication. It works with rigid, flexible, and metal-core substrates and places components ranging from fine-pitch BGAs and QFPs down to 0201 packages. Production spans prototype runs through high-volume in-line manufacturing, supported by Mycronic 200 placement machines, Heller reflow systems, wave soldering, and a BGA rework station. Quality inspection uses CRX-100 X-ray, benchtop AOI, and manual checks.

Technotronix serves the automotive, electronics, telecommunications, medical, renewable energy, and defense industries. Its medical portfolio includes ECG recorders, bio-analytical instruments, dialysis equipment, and hearing aids. The company also supports electric vehicle prototyping and LED lighting projects, working with OEMs, startups, and larger enterprises that require scalable, cost-effective manufacturing.

The company emphasizes flexibility, offering no minimum order quantities, 24-hour prototype assembly turnaround, and both kitted and turnkey options. It holds ISO 9001:2015, AS9100 Rev. D, and ANAB ISO/IEC 17021 accreditations, and maintains a global vendor network to meet time-critical demands. Technotronix states that customer relations, integrity, and real-time quality inspection differentiate its service.

about:
Techstar Molding operates from Pasadena, Texas, in the Houston metropolitan area. For over 40 years the company has provided custom plastic injection molding services, serving customers ranging from entrepreneurs launching new products to large corporations with established production needs. No founders are named in public materials, and ownership structure is not disclosed.

The company runs a full-service injection molding operation that covers design consulting, rapid prototyping, mold construction, production molding, assembly, packaging, and logistics. Its press lineup spans 150 to 1,000 tons with shot capacities exceeding seven pounds, enabling both low-volume and high-volume runs. Value-added capabilities include insert molding, single- and multi-cavity tooling, manual and automated assembly, finishing, labeling, kitting, and just-in-time or vendor-managed inventory programs.

Techstar serves a diverse industrial base that includes automotive, industrial equipment, agriculture, food service, construction, consumer goods, chemical packaging, HVAC, and oil and gas. The firm works with clients of all sizes, from startups needing prototype parts to established manufacturers requiring sustained production volumes.

Techstar emphasizes a turnkey, customer-first model, describing itself as reliable, responsive, and willing to go the extra mile. The company highlights its American-made production, collaborative engineering approach, and ability to manage projects from concept through delivery as key differentiators.

name: Teets Cattle Company
old_description: At Teets Cattle Company, we believe simple is best. That’s why we take pride in raising our cattle and crops right here on our farm alongside our family. We work together as a family to provide food for our nation.
about:
Teets Cattle Company is a family-owned farm based in Lost River, West Virginia. The operation was established by Matt and Jill Teets, who run it alongside their three sons—Justin, JW, and Jordan. While the exact founding year is not publicly disclosed, the family has built a reputation around traditional values, a love of the land, and a commitment to hard work.

The farm raises beef cattle and grows crops, selling cuts directly to consumers through a farm-to-table model. In addition to daily livestock and crop management, the company organizes several annual community events, including the Bulls N’ Barrels Rodeo, the Teets/Griswold Mt Classic Production Sale, and the Teets/Griswold Pounds to Profit Bull Sale, which attract buyers and spectators from across the region.

Teets Cattle Company primarily serves individual consumers seeking locally sourced meat and agricultural buyers looking for breeding stock. Its production sales provide a venue for other cattle producers to acquire genetics, while the direct-to-table offering appeals to households in West Virginia and surrounding areas.

The Teets family emphasizes simplicity and stewardship as their guiding principles. They state that their approach—raising animals and crops on their own land, without intermediaries—reflects a desire to provide food for the nation while preserving the heritage of family farming.

old_description: Our people are at the heart of what we do. They are driving force behind our success as a contract manufacturer of medical devices. Their expertise, dedication, and passion ensure that we consistently deliver high-quality products and services to our customers.
about:
Tegra Medical operates from its headquarters in Franklin, Massachusetts, with additional manufacturing sites in Costa Rica, Switzerland, Malaysia, China, and Singapore. The company describes itself as a contract manufacturer with decades of expertise in the medical device sector, though a specific founding year and founder names are not disclosed in its public materials.

Tegra Medical provides end-to-end contract manufacturing for medical devices, spanning design and prototyping at its GENESIS Tech Center® through full-scale production, assembly, packaging, and sterilization. Core processes include injection molding, precision grinding for sharp tips, and wire and tubing fabrication with secondary operations such as cutting, coating, and custom mandrel work. The company highlights a global footprint across six countries but does not publish facility square footage, headcount, or annual part volumes.

The firm serves medical device OEMs across oncology, ophthalmics, women's health, advanced orthopedics (including spine and trauma implants), minimally invasive surgery, drug delivery, cardiovascular and neurology, cardiac rhythm management, and robotic-assisted surgery. Its Quick Wire & Tubing store supports cardiovascular and neurovascular prototyping with off-the-shelf and customized stainless steel, nitinol, and coated wire and tubing.

Tegra Medical emphasizes a 'true end-to-end' model that consolidates the supply chain for customers, backed by ISO 13485 certification, FDA QSR compliance, and FDA registration. The company cites black-belt certified engineers, real-time statistical process control, lean and Six Sigma methodologies, and sustainability investments such as solar power and Industry 4.0 automation as differentiators.
